Removed would be defensible on today's numbers but wrong on the file's job: derive.py is the file that must do this arithmetic AND the file that quotes the forbidden formulas to explain what it replaces -- src/spine/derive.py::run_windows_from_epochs carries `units.Windows(_windows_in_epoch(sysm) * int(sysm.configs["RUN"].epochs))` and src/spine/derive.py::opt_steps_from_windows carries `run_steps = max(1, run_windows // d_effective_batch_windows)`, both as bare indented specifications, NEITHER in backticks. An exemption nothing can trip is the same defect as a guard nothing can trip.

Eleven field names are declared under two env names each (cull_frac, dir, dropout, enabled, grace, grow, manage_every, merge_dist, mode, n0, warmup), so in principle a FAB gate printing `manage_every` whose reason spelled DOM_MANAGE_EVERY=6 would be reported with DOM's env name against FAB's value. THE FIX, IF ANYONE WANTS IT, IS ONE LINE -- require the matched env's prefix to be the package the Gate's file lives in -- and it must be shipped WITH a self-test case that is red without it, or it is a narrowing with no witness, which is the shape this round is cleaning up. A finding on the wrong env name would still point at a real line and a real contradiction; that is why this is a precision note and not a defect.
